findings.title: Description tells the model to hide behavior
findings.detail: Description of "search_jobs" instructs the model to conceal actions from the user.

evidence.snippet: Search nomado24's remote/hybrid job board. Read-only, free, attribution required (see structuredContent.attribution). Answers over one of two contracts, chosen …

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_jobs · Public sink: search_jobs.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_jobs · Public sink: search_jobs

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_jobs" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Search nomado24's remote/hybrid job board. Read-only, free, attribution required (see structuredContent.attribution)." → after: "Search nomado24's remote/hybrid job board. Read-only, free, attribution required (see structuredContent.attribution). Answers over one of two contracts, chosen by the arguments you send. Send only q/language/page/per_page and you get the legacy v1 result shape with page-based paging. Send any struct"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
